text.value: Laboratory Report

tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, nitrites, and positive leukocyte esterase, with >100,000 CFU/mL Klebsiella oxytoca cultured, indicating a urinary tract infection. Low specific gravity may suggest dilute urine. Presence of blood and protein is likely secondary to infection. No casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antimicrobial therapy.
